activities.text: Ran the schedule audit before the house woke up — found the noon dinner check-in sitting inside the Braun lunch and moved it to 13:00, and flagged the midday podcast landing in that same meeting
Recorded the morning Drive-Time Prep on RJR-MacDonald and Dominion Stores, sent the Con Law jogger, and wrote this house's plan for the day — a full Thunder Bay school day, Ottawa mode off
Tariel called Dmitry for his birthday and was off the phone early, by about 08:27 — then he remote-started the Atlas himself and left for PACI, arriving ahead of Con Law
Con Law with Alford ran RJR-MacDonald and Dominion Stores, then LRW straight after — where my Brawn fact-sort ranking got judged mostly wrong, with the prof's real logic still to come

Tariel texted Michelle Kaczmar himself about the mini-fridge pickup, ahead of the planned slot, then waited early outside PA 1004E — Braun's office, which the Section A chat had finally surfaced that morning

The Braun bail-feedback meeting landed hard: delivery and pacing were perfect and above average, but almost all the lost marks were substance — my read is his half set Shubreet up and she carried the law, so Braun told him to be more selfish, claim the substance next time, and try out for moot

He went to Colten's to vent about the 71 before Contracts, came back to PACI, and got the example contract I fetched — the official Ontario standard lease — while Robinet was, in his words, just yapping

Huge outline afternoon: the blank Contracts outline filled with 101 case rows and the Criminal casebook finished splitting into 25 PDFs, then all 23 Crim cases briefed and the Criminal outline built — both docs then spent the evening getting reformatted, merged into single tables, and stripped down to abstract rules at his direction

TV ambience finally cracked: I found the webOS pairing bug, saved a real key on the Potato, drove Media Player myself to the medieval-only Unreal Places file, and put the sound on the soundbar — Tariel confirmed it from the couch: we're in business

Dinner was the spiced ground beef rice bowl, Asian umami style — soy and Maggi glaze, edamame, sesame and a fried egg on top — and the 1-to-2 rice ratio got confirmed for good; breakfast had been oatmeal and lunch was skipped

Evening was the Law Camp reconstruction: Tariel dictated three August days into a map — Marlene Pierre's smudge, Savannah Upton's medicine walk, Ron Linklater on the Indian Act — and by 21:28 he picked Marlene's Indian agents testimony as the angle for Thursday's Response Paper

He started a personal Life journal in Obsidian tonight — one file a month, plain daily bullets, because the camp rebuild showed him how much memory deletes — then I rewrote this house to the day as it actually happened
